name: Gasthof-Pension Gradlwirt
beschreibung: The Gasthof-Pension Gradlwirt is located in the municipality of Niederndorf in Tirol. It is a family-run establishment with traditional character. The atmosphere in the house is quiet and personal. Guests can avail themselves of comfortably furnished rooms. The surroundings are characterized by the alpine landscape of the Kaisergebirge. The facilities include a restaurant with regional cuisine and parking. The nearby area offers opportunities for hiking and ski excursions.
